plan.notes: Term-by-term sample plan transcribed verbatim from the official Augustana University 2022-2023 Undergraduate General Catalog, Business Administration Major page (degree BA per augie.edu: 'A Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) in business administration degree from Augustana University'). The 2022-2023 catalog is the most recent catalog year whose sample plan is published inline in HTML; the current (2026-2027) catalog links its sample plan as a Google Sheet, which is not retrievable via text-fetch tools (direct fetches return HTTP 400 from docs.google.com). 'Core, Major, Minor or Elective Course (3-4)' slots seeded at base 3 cr as choice:true. ECON 270/PSYC 270 and BSAD 382/ACCT 382 OR-pairs seeded as single choice slots (take one). 'BSAD Emphasis Course (3 cr)' slots seeded as choice:true (emphasis areas require an additional 15 cr; some courses offered every other year, so students start emphasis courses in the third year). Required courses COSC 205/BSAD 205 (Management Information Systems I) and the BSAD 200-level-or-higher elective are not explicitly placed in the plan; filler slots absorb them. Year 2 Fall catalog guidance: 'Students are encouraged to take BSAD 310, 320 and 330 during their Second and Third year. If Marketing Emphasis, take BSAD 310. If Finance Emphasis, take BSAD 330. All others take BSAD 320 first.' Catalog states 124 total credits are needed for degree completion.
